title: ilex ambigua f. montana
intro: Ilex ambigua f. montana, commonly known as a variant of the Ilex ambigua plant, is a species of flowering plant in the family Aquifoliaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to protect against oxidative stress and cell damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
